pages.title: Fisheries sector — record budget and PMMSY

facts.text: Union Budget 2026–27: record ₹2,761.80 crore for fisheries; benefits 3 crore+ fishers
facts.head: News

facts.text: India: second-largest fish producer — ~8% of world production
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Fish production: 95.79 lakh tonnes (2013–14) → 197.75 lakh tonnes (2024–25)
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Share in Agricultural GVA: 7.43%; seafood exports: ₹62,408 crore — frozen shrimp dominant
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Inland waters: 31.5 lakh ha; coastline: 11,099 km; EEZ: 24 lakh sq. km; livelihoods ~30 million
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Scheme: Blue Revolution; Key facts: Began in 1980s — scientific aquaculture
facts.head: Schemes

facts.text: Scheme: PMMSY; Key facts: Launched 2020; ₹20,050 crore; "Blue Revolution 2.0"; infrastructure + value chain
facts.head: Schemes

facts.text: Scheme: National Fisheries Digital Platform (NFDP); Key facts: Digital identity of fishers; targeted delivery
facts.head: Schemes

facts.text: Scheme: FIDF; Key facts: Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund — harbours, cold storage, landing centres
facts.head: Schemes

facts.text: Scheme: KCC for fishers; Key facts: Short-term credit / working capital
facts.head: Schemes

facts.text: ⚠ PMMSY = long-term infrastructure; KCC = short-term credit; PMMSY does not rely on fleet expansion
facts.head: Schemes

facts.text: Techniques: Biofloc, Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS)
facts.head: Schemes

pages.title: Balakrishnan Commission on SC status for converted Dalits — third extension

facts.text: Third extension to Commission of Inquiry headed by ex-CJI K.G. Balakrishnan — till June 2026
facts.head: News

facts.text: Constituted: October 2022 — whether SC status be extended to Dalits converted to Christianity and Islam
facts.head: News

facts.text: Article 341: President specifies SCs for each State/UT after consulting Governor; ⚠ list modified only by Parliament
facts.head: Constitutional framework

facts.text: Constitution (Scheduled Castes) Order, 1950: originally Hindus only → Sikhs (1956) → Buddhists (1990)
facts.head: Constitutional framework

facts.text: SC reservation in legislatures — Arts 330, 332; periodically extended (latest up to 2030); ⚠ no reservation in private sector jobs
facts.head: Constitutional framework

facts.text: Extension of two more months — report deadline October 10, 2024 → October 10, 2025 → April 10, 2026 → June 10, 2026; notified by Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
facts.head: More details

facts.text: Set up October 6, 2022; members — Justice K.G. Balakrishnan, Prof. Sagarambal Krishnan (as in source), ex-IAS Rajita Singh
facts.head: More details

facts.text: K.G. Balakrishnan — 37th CJI (2007–2010), ⚠ first Dalit CJI
facts.head: More details

pages.title: UGC Equity Regulations 2026 stayed by Supreme Court

facts.text: SC interim stay on UGC (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026
facts.head: News

facts.text: Context: caste discrimination, student suicides (e.g. Abeda Salim Tadvi case); concerns over misuse, no general-category representation
facts.head: News

facts.text: Equal Opportunity Centre (EOC) — nodal body in every HEI
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Equity Committees chaired by head of institution — SC, ST, OBC, women, PwD representation
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: 24/7 grievance system — helplines, portals, Equity Officers, Equity Squads
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Bi-annual public reports; annual compliance report to UGC
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Caste discrimination defined as against SC, ST, OBC; ⚠ no explicit penalty for false complaints
facts.head: Key provisions

facts.text: Art 15(1): no discrimination by the State (citizens only; ⚠ "descent" not a ground)
facts.head: Constitutional basis

facts.text: Art 15(2): applies to State and private (shops, hotels, public places)
facts.head: Constitutional basis

facts.text: Art 15(3): special provisions for women and children (also executive measures)
facts.head: Constitutional basis

facts.text: Art 15(4): SEBCs, SCs, STs; Art 15(5): reservation in educational institutions incl. private
facts.head: Constitutional basis

facts.text: 103rd Amendment (2019): 10% EWS — Arts 15(6), 16(6)
facts.head: Constitutional basis

facts.text: 77th Amendment (1995): Art 16(4A) — reservation in promotion for SC/ST
facts.head: Constitutional basis

facts.text: Indra Sawhney (1992): creamy layer for OBCs only; M. Nagaraj (2006): quantifiable data conditions for promotion quota
facts.head: Constitutional basis
